title: LegacyHistoryService
responsibility: Reads imported legacy reports from the evidence branch for the history index and resolves their media.

inputs.name: LegacyHistoryService.constructor.root
inputs.description: The repository root passed to EvidenceTreeAdapter and LfsAdapter. Those adapters use it to read evidence history and stored media; this service does not validate the path.

inputs.name: LegacyHistoryService.entries.media
inputs.description: The history media service used to place bytes and metadata for legacy media items with a sha256. Items without a sha256 return media set to null without calling this service.

outputs.name: LegacyHistoryService.entries
outputs.description: The latest schema-valid report for each record id from the current evidence tip, sorted by startedAt and then id. Each entry includes linked commit information when its revision resolves to a commit, a gap when it does not, and resolved media. The result is empty when there is no tip, and malformed reports are skipped.

inputs.name: LegacyHistoryService.entries.media
